day.prompt: Real editorial interior photograph for a high-end lighting design shop. Straight-on, one-point-perspective view of a serene living and dining room; the back wall is parallel to the frame. Warm limewash plaster walls, a pale oak floor, and a tall steel-framed window on the right third with late-morning sun raking in, casting crisp mullion shadows across the floor and the back wall. Five designer lamps, all switched off, each a beautiful sculptural object, spread across the frame at different heights with space between them: on the left, an amber mouth-blown glass mushroom table lamp on a low travertine console beside a stoneware vase of dry branches; in the centre, a large white washi-paper lantern pendant hanging low over a solid walnut dining table with four woven chairs; centre-right, an alabaster wall sconce on the back wall; on the right, a slim brushed-brass arc floor lamp curving over a cream bouclé lounge chair; in the far right corner by the window, a tall pleated-paper column floor lamp. The upper-left third of the back wall is calm and empty. Linen and a few ceramics, no clutter.

night.prompt: Edit this photograph: it is now night, two hours after sunset. {keep} The window shows deep blue night with a few distant warm city lights; the sunlight and its shadows are completely gone. All five lamps are switched on at 2700 K: the amber glass mushroom lamp glows rich honey-gold and casts an amber pool on the console; the washi-paper pendant glows evenly with its fibres visible and pours light onto the walnut table; the alabaster sconce washes the wall above and below it; the brass arc lamp throws a soft pool over the bouclé chair; the pleated paper column glows softly in the corner. Each lamp makes its own pool of light; the ceiling, the corners and the upper-left wall fall into deep warm darkness, so most of the frame is dark. The lamps reflect faintly in the window glass. Natural night interior photography exposed for the shades: no blown whites, deep blacks with detail, fine film grain, no haze, no light beams.

dark.prompt: Edit this photograph: switch off all five lamps. {keep} Remove every glow, pool of light and reflection the lamps made; the shades are unlit and pale. The room is dark, lit only by the faint deep-blue night coming through the window on the right; deep shadows with a little detail. Natural night photography, fine film grain.

solo-mushroom.prompt: Edit this photograph: switch on only the amber glass mushroom table lamp on the console at the left; every other lamp stays off. {keep} It glows rich honey-gold at 2700 K and casts a warm amber pool on the console, the vase and the wall behind it, falling off naturally into the dark room. Natural night photography, fine film grain.
